title: Relay A: Wonky Hexagon (bug hunt)
body:
Goal: build a broken project exactly as shown, then find and fix its two bugs. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension. Work as a relay team: the driver builds, the navigator reads this card and fills in the relay baton.

What it should do

Draw one closed hexagon (6 equal sides of 80 steps) in the middle of the stage, then the cat says "Done!".

Build steps

  1. Start a new project. Click Add Extension and choose Pen.
  2. Set the cat's Size to 40.
  3. Build the script below on the cat exactly as written, bugs and all.
  4. Click the green flag. Compare the stage with "What it should do".
  5. Use the four detective steps. Fix one thing at a time and test after each change.
  6. Write both bugs and fixes on your relay baton (workbook, Exercise 6.1).

The script in words (with two bugs)

Cat sprite:

  • when green flag clicked
  • erase all
  • go to x: 0 y: 0
  • point in direction 90
  • pen down
  • repeat 6:
    • move 80 steps
    • turn right 50 degrees
    • pen up
  • say "Done!" for 2 seconds

The four detective steps

  1. What did I expect?
  2. What happened?
  3. Read the blocks one at a time with your finger.
  4. Change one thing, then test again.

Expected behavior

After your fixes: clicking the green flag clears the stage, draws one closed hexagon with 6 equal sides starting from the middle, and then the cat says "Done!".

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Run the script and look at the stage. Is the shape closed? How many sides did it draw? Then follow the blocks with your finger, one at a time.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Two things are wrong. One is about how far the cat turns each time. The other is about where a Pen block sits inside the repeat loop. Fix one thing, then test, then fix the other.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Think about the turn: a full circle is 360 degrees, and a hexagon has ____ equal corners, so each turn is 360 divided by ____. For the pen, ask what it does after the first side. Is that what you want for the other five sides?
